articles.title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
articles.description: Five people were killed in a wave of strikes which follow Ukraine's successful targeting of the Crimean Bridge.

articles.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
articles.description: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

articles.title: US army warns detonation of unstable explosives will create toxic plume
articles.description: The Army has delayed the controlled explosion of unstable lead azide in eastern Iowa to Monday after concerns from residents and lawmakers.

articles.title: China issues Mount Fuji warning as family of missing climber offers reward
articles.description: The $75,000 reward offered by Chen Jie's family has sparked fears of more reckless climbing attempts.

articles.title: Putin vows 'far more painful' response to Ukraine's strikes on Crimean Bridge
articles.description: The bridge - a symbol of Russia's occupation of the Crimean Peninsula - suffered major damaged following a combined attack by Ukraine earlier this week.

articles.title: Venezuela signs military deal with US less than a year after Maduro's removal
articles.description: The US Secretary of Defence says Venezuela has "gone from our most aggressive regional threat to a compliant security partner".

articles.title: Burnham says Europe 'ready to enter negotiations' to help end Russia's war in Ukraine
articles.description: Europe is ready to enter negotiations to help end Russia's war in Ukraine, Andy Burnham has said.

articles.title: EU reveals it suffered 'AI-powered' cyber attack
articles.description: The EU has revealed it suffered a cyber attack powered by AI last month and some of its digital tools are still offline as a result.
